title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask — Episode7 The Mask Is Discarded

meta.Event Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome back.
You're home late.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I needed some time to think...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see...
Well, things have been a little hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I wanted to apologize for going a little too far yesterday. So, I made the beef stew you like so much for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I bought some higher-quality meat than usual, so I'm sure it turned out very nicely. Eat as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Before that, there's something I need to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Something to tell me? Yes, what is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for hiding so many things from you until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for continuing to make music after saying that I'd stop, and not telling you about my finals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know that you're worried about me, and you have every right to be angry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'm glad you finally understand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise to study as hard as I can... So please...
Let me keep making music with Kanade and the others.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll make sure my grades won't slip.
You don't have to worry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you're willing to say this much...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: This music you make must mean quite a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it's very important to me! So...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that you have a wonderful hobby. So, I'm not against your wish to continue with it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is now really the time for that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
This goes without saying, Mafuyu...
You know that you have to make sacrifices if you really wish to get accepted into medical school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: What do you think is going to happen if you don't put all of your energy into your entrance exams?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your peers are all doing everything in their power to maintain good grades, while yours are slipping...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: At this rate, Mafuyu, you won't be able to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Your dreams mean everything to you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, for now, you'll just have to be patient, and study and work towards that goal...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
It's always been your dream to become a doctor. That's why you've been studying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's why you've been attending cram school and staying up late each night...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I admire doctors greatly since they save people's lives and help those in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd also be able to live very comfortably and not have to worry about my finances...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I understand why someone would want to become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to do more for others...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to be right by their side when they're in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But... You can do that as a doctor, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But... I don't think I actually want to become one...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mom, do you remember what happened when I was little?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I caught a cold and you stayed by my side until I got better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I know now that the medicine the doctor prescribed helped me get better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But more than that... The way you stayed by my side... It filled me with so much warmth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I want to help others the same way... I want them to feel that warmth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to spend more time finding a dream that suits me better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How can you say such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How did things end up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you spent so much time studying and working so hard to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But now... You want to give up... You're willing to let some passing fancy derail you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And that girl is definitely to blame.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She only seems to do as she pleases without studying or going to school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You felt some admiration for that lifestyle, didn't you, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Kanade has nothing to do with this...
Mom, I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: This would've never happened if I supported you more properly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know I've sounded overbearing at times and kept you from doing certain things...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: As a result, I was probably much harder on you compared to other mothers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, I did it all for your sake...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was only thinking about you having a happy and fulfilling future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because... That's what will make me happy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I... I didn't mean to hurt you...
This wasn't what I wanted...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was just trying to tell you how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Mom cares this much about me...
She just said so herself...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <How you feel right now... That's what the real you wants.>
